crossRefs.note: As a dream when one wakes up, so, Lord, when you awake, you will despise their fantasies.
He rode on a cherub, and flew. Yes, he soared on the wings of the wind.
You sweep them away as they sleep. In the morning they sprout like new grass.
The multitude of all the nations that fight against Ariel, even all who fight against her and her stronghold, and who…
It will be like when a hungry man dreams, and behold, he eats; but he awakes, and his hunger isn’t satisfied; or like…

translations.web: He will fly away as a dream, and will not be found. Yes, he will be chased away like a vision of the night.
translations.bsb: He will fly away like a dream, never to be found; he will be chased away like a vision in the night.
translations.kjv: He shall fly away as a dream, and shall not be found: yea, he shall be chased away as a vision of the night.
translations.asv: He shall fly away as a dream, and shall not be found: Yea, he shall be chased away as a vision of the night.
